result: Both ordering branches pass offline: an unchanged completed snapshot keeps its reading and confirmation; changed readings require a fresh officer confirmation before citations can be written. Live card qualification remains pending.

findings.finding: prepare reviews the package, reads it back, then calls prepareIntakeTargetsTx at line 103. intake-targets.ts:128 calls queueAnchorEvidenceTx; target creation also calls it at line 86.

The anchor digest pins ordered target id, package id and package revision. queueAnchorEvidenceTx compares that digest, not unconditionally: queued jobs are left alone; a running or completed job with another digest is replaced. areas/areas.ts:1630 advances package revision during review, so that is a genuinely different candidate pin even if source bytes and BIN literals stay unchanged.

The evidence job reads current anchors when it starts, not necessarily the queue-time anchors. Before this change, prepare compared only the older queue-time payload digest. A queued job allowed to see later drafted buildings could therefore finish with current contents yet be queued again. Completion now stores the actual repeatable-read snapshot digest in the existing operations ledger; queueAnchorEvidenceTx prefers it. No immutable job payload, input manifest or confirmation is rewritten.

recheckTx raises INTAKE_EVIDENCE_STALE before the draft and again before commit. intake-evidence.ts:685 checks profile hash; included/excluded source id, revision, hash, bytes and latest status; included reading job id, result hash and coverage; all sources named; target package id, revision and review; candidate hash, target and exact locator; and link manifest. Only matched candidates can be accepted; expiry is checked separately.

RF1 refreshes choices in an open unsaved form, not a stored confirmation. confirm-model.ts:145 reconcileChoices keeps only the same evidence/building/outcome and requires another acknowledgement after changed pins. Previously confirmedOf hid accepted candidate ids forever, including stable ids of newer readings; it now excludes superseded readings, including the local confirmation cache.

The targets projection previously hid review metadata once commit advanced the package beyond its reviewed revision. That made Studio targetsOf refuse re-confirmation as no current review. It now exposes only the exact preceding review of a committed package; confirm-model.ts:246 names that reviewed revision, matching the existing committed view in evidenceStateTx. No new package review authority is introduced.

A retry previously retried every unwritten historical confirmation, so even a new confirmation could not remove the stale one from the pending set. A later explicit acceptance now supersedes an earlier pending confirmation only for the same building/key and only when it accepts every earlier accepted candidate. Written receipts remain visible when resolving supersession, preventing old confirmations returning on replay. All replacement pins and expiry still pass recheckTx.

decision: Keep package revision in the reading pins: it is present in candidate contents, so ignoring it or moving an old confirmation would be dishonest. Avoid only duplicate reads whose actual anchor snapshot already equals the current digest. Add optional superseded confirmation-read metadata and reoffer matches for all genuinely newer readings; never carry an officer confirmation to changed contents. Reuse the operations ledger for the completed snapshot receipt; no schema migration or parallel authority.

rehearsalEvidence.qualification: Read from Git in k3, not from runtime data. The receipts show the second job and timing, but contain neither evidence job payload nor anchor snapshot hashes. They cannot establish which digest difference triggered this particular second job. The code proves both the queue-time-digest defect and the review-revision change path; regression tests cover both without claiming unavailable historical pins.
